explanation: This function is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because .format(name, also) embeds user-supplied values directly into the INSERT query passed to cursor.execute(). Untrusted input containing quotes could alter the SQL command and manipulate the database. The repair switches to named placeholders %(name)s and %(also)s, but supplies a positional tuple (name, also,) instead of a dictionary, which causes a runtime binding error.
